milestones.title: Commissioning recovery
milestones.summary: Starting restored following battery charging after an oil-level correction. Further operating observation and inspection remain required; this is not a confirmed diagnosis.

milestones.title: First dirt-day evaluation
milestones.summary: Operator-reported bucket handling, playground-area preparation, grading, dirt movement and pallet-fork practice. Field photographs await review. A full pallet lift is not documented.

nightOps.title: V1 - Removable magnetic lights
nightOps.summary: Battery-powered magnetic lights and purple accents: 12 initially reported; eight more planned for a 20-light target. Removable side and rear placement supports inspection.

nightOps.title: V2 - Hardwired work lighting
nightOps.summary: LASFIT light bar and AUXBEAM pods are proposed for forward and wider worksite coverage, with desired amber/white capability. Factory pods stay ignition controlled; purple accents use a separate proposed circuit.

nightOps.title: V3 - Engine-off illumination
nightOps.status: Design candidate - not purchased or installed
nightOps.summary: A dedicated auxiliary battery, protected independent circuits, fused distribution, weather-resistant enclosure and compatible charging are planned. A 12V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery is a candidate, not an installed upgrade.

maintenanceSummary: Oil-level correction and restart after charging are operator-reported. Inspection follow-up remains open. Detailed troubleshooting, defect photographs, supplier messages and warranty discussions remain in Digital HQ.

mediaSummary: Delivery, crate-opening photographs and factory startup guidance remain available. Field, charging, lighting and inspection evidence awaits review; factory footage is not presented as field-test proof.
